collection.description: A child falls during a running game and insists they are fine, though their knee is bruised and their pride is wounded.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) falls during a running game and insists they are fine, though their knee is bruised and their pride is wounded.

choices.label: Offer First Aid Without an Audience

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) accepts a cool cloth and quietly rejoins the group later.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) needs more time than expected and appreciates not being rushed.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) asks to be alone, and (friend) respects it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Everyone switches to a gentler challenge.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) objects to being treated as fragile, so the group asks what they prefer.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) admits being laughed at hurt more than the fall.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) says the fall was funny too, once the sting has passed.
